Picking one, the four convert as one panel at the neutral radius 36.5, opened where they meet again round the axis by the corner gap 2: the blank (73 pi - 2) by 20, 1460 pi - 40; folded, the tube less the gap's 2/36.5 rad, 2920 pi - 80.
